notes: GAAP report. Governmental receipts/disbursements from Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (p4), Total Governmental Funds column. Governmental expenditures are listed by object (no function), so Personnel/Operating/Supplies are split by the p4 fund columns, each taking its fund's function (General general government, Street streets/highways, Police public safety, Park culture/recreation, Community Development economic development; Equipment Maintenance/Replacement and Special Assessments general government; Other Governmental Funds other), all marked review. Transfers in/out are zero. Business-type lines from Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position, Proprietary Funds, Total column (p6); no single total printed so receipts = operating revenues 15,332,278 + investment earnings 176,297 and disbursements = total operating expenses 14,209,811 + interest expense 54,949 (ties to business-type expenses 14,264,760 on p2). Depreciation is not shown separately (within operating lines). Balance sheet from government-wide Statement of Net Position, Total primary government column (p1); Due from other funds / Due to other funds eliminate to zero in Total and Leases are '-', so are omitted. ending_cash = governmental funds cash and cash equivalents on balance sheet (p3). Detail: only the cash-basis budget-to-actual schedule for primary governmental funds (p8) is recorded; it is on a different (cash/budget) basis than the GAAP statements (e.g. property tax 2,059,474 vs 2,083,249) and its beginning/ending balances are 4,206,330 / 4,347,726; it is kept separate from receipts/disbursements. Transfers in actual is '-' (budget 3,206). Read pages 1-8 of 8 Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (p4, p6) replace the combined schedule.

report_discrepancies.note: Statement of Net Position has an Eliminations column of (7,482,286) on Due from other funds and Due to other funds. The split lines are the Governmental and Business-type columns before elimination (Internal Balances lines), so asset lines add to 53,823,051 and liability lines to 18,337,744, versus printed totals 46,340,765 and 10,855,458 after elimination. Net position is unaffected.
